candidates.source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) — crz.gov.sk
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory central register of contracts of ministries, central state bodies, public-law institutions and their subordinate organisations since 1.1.2011. Under Act 546/2010 a mandatorily-published contract is effective only the day after publication here, so signed banking/payment contracts (account keeping, card acceptance, ATM operation, cash handling, payment gateway) appear with counterparty, price and full PDF — including direct awards that never produced a tender notice. Search UI exposes filters for dodávateľ, IČO dodávateľa, názov zmluvy, cena v EUR s DPH, dátum zverejnenia and rezort; the portal reports several million published contracts.
candidates.legal_status: official government register; statutory publication duty (Act 211/2000 §5a, Act 546/2010)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the bulk XML change-batch export (see separate candidate) for the spine; use the web search UI with Slovak keyword sets (bankov*, platobn* kart*, bankomat, POS terminál, platobná brána, hotovosť, ceniny) for targeted discovery; fetch contract detail pages /zmluva/{id} and attached PDFs. Respect the documented rate limits.

register zmlúv objednávky faktúry ministerstvo bankomat akceptácia platobných kariet

candidates.source_name: CRZ bulk export — denné zmenové dávky (XML/ZIP)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable daily change batches of the whole CRZ in XML packed as ZIP, documented on the national open-data catalogue (formerly data.gov.sk/dataset/crz, now redirecting to data.slovensko.sk). Documented download pattern http://www.crz.gov.sk/export/rrrr-mm-dd.zip with stated crawl limits (roughly 1 request / 2 s daytime 06:00-20:00, under 3 req/s at night). This is the backbone for building a longitudinal SK banking/payments public-spend dataset rather than ad-hoc searching.
candidates.access_status: public open data; catalogue page rendered poorly to a plain fetch (JS app) — dataset resources not confirmed by me
candidates.legal_status: national open data catalogue, open licence expected (not confirmed)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Backfill by iterating the dated ZIP export endpoint, parse XML into a contracts table, then filter by supplier IČO of SK banks/PSPs and by Slovak keyword regex. Honour the published rate limits.
queries_used: crz.gov.sk API open data zmluvy datahub data.gov.sk centrálny register zmlúv export
candidates.observed_blocker: data.gov.sk/dataset/crz returned HTTP 302 to data.slovensko.sk/datasety/crz; that page rendered as an empty JS shell to a plain fetch — unverified, not dead

candidates.why_relevant: Institution-indexed view of the central register (per-ministry / per-public-body contract lists, e.g. Slovenská pošta a.s.). Useful when you want the complete contract set of one obliged entity (e.g. Štátna pokladnica, Slovenská pošta, Sociálna poisťovňa) rather than a keyword slice, and as a cross-check against crz.gov.sk indexing gaps.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl entity index pages (index.php?ID=...) for target obliged entities; use as a secondary index keyed to CRZ contract ids.

candidates.source_name: eGovZmluvy — zmluvy.egov.sk (verejný register odberateľských vzťahov)
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial publishing platform used by a large number of Slovak municipalities, cities, budgetary/contributory organisations and schools to meet the Act 546/2010 duty for zmluvy, objednávky and faktúry. Since 1.4.2022 it auto-forwards to CRZ, but it retains its own searchable per-entity register with invoices and orders — the layer that reveals recurring cash-handling, ATM, card-acceptance and bank-fee spend at sub-national level that CRZ contract metadata alone does not show.

candidates.legal_status: private platform hosting statutory disclosures; ToS not reviewed

candidates.why_relevant: Cleaned, consolidated and cross-linked copies of state registers including the central register of contracts, register of legal entities (RPO/RPO v2), commercial register and register of financial statements, exposed via API and SQL. negative_findings.description: No official REST API for CRZ was found. Community requests for a CRZ API exist on platforma.slovensko.digital (thread 'Centrálny register zmlúv API'), and the only official machine-readable channel found is the dated ZIP/XML change-batch export plus the HTML search UI.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk XML export exists; no documented official query API. Third-party APIs (Slovensko.Digital Datahub) fill the gap but are commercial.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must be crawl/bulk-parse based, with rate-limit compliance, not API-based; budget for parsing effort and for a possible paid aggregator dependency.

negative_findings.description: Slovak law removes exactly the contract types most relevant to this cell from full publication in some cases: sources describing §5a ods. 5 of Act 211/2000 state that for certain letters (incl. contracts on securities/financial instruments and contracts securing the provision of payment services) only information about the conclusion of the contract is published, not the contract text. Sources also state that since 31.3.2022 only NBS retains a full entity-level exemption.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payment-services and financial-instrument contracts may appear only as a bare notice of conclusion, without price or terms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Absence of a full contract in CRZ is not evidence of no deal; analysis must treat these as censored observations and fall back to invoice registers, ÚVO notices and institutional pages.

negative_findings.description: https://data.gov.sk/dataset/crz returned HTTP 302 to https://data.slovensko.sk/datasety/crz; the target rendered as an empty JS shell to a plain fetch, so the resource list, licence and update frequency could not be read.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dataset almost certainly live at the new national catalogue domain, but its distributions were not confirmed by me.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The open-data catalogue migrated (data.gov.sk to data.slovensko.sk); any stored CRZ dataset URLs in the collection pipeline are likely stale and need re-resolution, and the page probably needs a JS-capable fetcher.

negative_findings.description: A targeted Slovak query combining 'spracovanie platobných kariet', 'platobný terminál' and 'POS terminál' against CRZ returned mostly generic CRZ landing/FAQ pages and bank T&C PDFs rather than contract hits, indicating the public web index does not reach deep into CRZ contract detail pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: General web search is a poor discovery channel for individual CRZ contracts; only a handful of contract detail URLs surfaced (e.g. /zmluva/8907711 'Zmluva o akceptácii platobných kariet', /zmluva/12680586 electronic banking services).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Discovery must be done inside CRZ's own search or over the bulk export, not via search engines; otherwise coverage will be badly biased.

Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB, Prima banka, Poštová banka, 365.bank, UniCredit, plus acquirers and terminal vendors were not enumerated with IČOs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an IČO reference list of SK banks, payment institutions, acquirers and terminal/ATM vendors (from NBS register of supervised entities and RPO), then drive all CRZ/invoice harvesting by IČO rather than free text.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For any longitudinal claim before 2022, harvest the originating municipal/platform registers and archive sites separately rather than assuming CRZ completeness.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm the open-data licence on the national catalogue entry and read each aggregator's ToS before any commercial market-intelligence reuse or redistribution.

brief: Slovakia's signed-contract layer is unusually rich: because a mandatorily-published contract only takes effect the day after publication, the Centrálny register zmlúv (crz.gov.sk, with an institution-indexed mirror at zmluvy.gov.sk) holds the actual banking and payment contracts of the state — counterparty, price and PDF — including direct awards with no tender notice. The practical collection spine is the daily XML change-batch bulk export catalogued on the national open-data portal (migrated from data.gov.sk to data.slovensko.sk), since there is no official CRZ query API; commercial aggregators (Slovensko.Digital Datahub, uvostat) and open-source scrapers exist as accelerators. Below CRZ sits the institution-level layer that CRZ contract metadata misses: NBS (the one entity with a standing publication exemption, so its own zmluvy/objednávky/faktúry pages are the only channel), Štátna pokladnica with its account and payment-gateway terms, Sociálna poisťovňa, Finančná správa, Slovenská pošta, ministries and municipalities such as Bratislava, plus SaaS platforms (eGovZmluvy, RZOF) that carry the long tail. The main analytic caveat is legal: §5a ods. 5 of Act 211/2000 lets payment-services and financial-instrument contracts be disclosed as a bare notice of conclusion, so a missing contract must be treated as censored data, not as absence of a deal.
